decisions.reason: The cloud contact centre service builds on the firm's established offer and fits its announced strategy of customer-oriented hybrid cloud transformation, so dropping it after only one year would write off the investment and contradict that public direction, while weak early results can still be put down to ramp-up.

The number routing platform has a dedicated website page signalling visible public commitment and sits close to the core voice business, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn while results remain explainable as early-stage.
